title: com.docker.sandbox/cross-app-access@1
description: Lets the sandbox reach one resource application as the signed-in person: the runtime exchanges the person's enterprise sign-in for an identity assertion grant bound to the application's authorization server, redeems it there, and injects the access token into matching outbound requests outside the sandbox. Instance-shaped on name. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move.

name.description: Identifies the grant among the sandbox's tokens and names it in the runtime's ledger.

issuer.description: Issuer identifier of the resource application's authorization server: the audience of the identity assertion grant and where the runtime redeems it.

resource.description: Resource indicator the access token is bound to: an absolute URI without a fragment.

scopes.description: Scopes the access token may carry. The identity provider and the authorization server may grant fewer, never more.

inject.description: Outbound domains the runtime presents the access token to. Every domain must appear in the network policy's runtime allow list (or be covered by a bare wildcard), and no other cross-app-access or workload-token entry may list it.

header.description: Header carrying the access token. Defaults to Authorization.

format.description: Renders the access token into the header value with exactly one %s. Defaults to "Bearer %s".

scheme.description: An access token is presented as a header; scheme does not apply.

username.description: An access token is presented as a header; username does not apply.
